title: 微笑花园
scene: ONE giant smiling flower with FIVE broad rounded petals and ONE very large circular face center leans jauntily to one side out of a chunky softly curved flowerpot. TWO big expressive leaves, stem is a single solid black graceful line (not a skinny white outlined tube). Pot is ONE simple big form without rim bands or patterns. Solid black simple eyes, one open smile curve. Empty WHITE background, no ground line, no extra flowers, sun, clouds, insects, grass or small dots. Aim for 9–12 enormous colorable shapes, cute personality through pose.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished professional SIMPLE children's coloring-book illustration, square 1024x1024, for an Android tablet coloring game ages 5–12. Expert illustrator's warm expressive organic drawing with confident flowing curves, tasteful varied line weight and charming asymmetry; never geometric clip-art parts or a diagram. Make the main character or vehicle big, around 70–80% of the image, with a memorable playful pose and one clear amusing story beat. Only 10–16 LARGE enclosed white colorable shapes across the ENTIRE picture, hard maximum 20 including the background. Keep every colorable area broad and easy for a child's finger, no tiny enclosed islands. Use expressive solid-black simple eyes WITHOUT tiny white highlights, and open smile curves; large simple facial shapes. Omit decorative texture, fur tufts, narrow stripes, dense details, screws, tiny windows, scales, grass blades, confetti and background ornaments. Add only 1–2 BIG simple secondary props that support the scene. Background nearly empty WHITE, perhaps one broad sweeping ground/cloud curve and one large simple sun/star, never a detailed scene. Crisp clean bold BLACK outlines on pure WHITE: roughly 6px outer contours and 4px interior at 1024px, continuous CLOSED boundaries, generous blank coloring areas. No gray shading, color, gradient, hatching, sketch/construction marks, paper texture, text, logo, border, or watermark. Keep main subject and appendages inside safe white margins; no cropped character.
